Image Border Adder

Add a clean border or frame to any image — set thickness, color, and corner style, preview instantly, and download the framed PNG.

📖 How to use

  1. Upload your image.
  2. Set the border thickness and pick a color.
  3. Optionally round the outer corners.
  4. Download the framed PNG.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How thick can the border be?

Up to 200 px, so both thin hairlines and thick poster-style frames are possible.

Does the border cover part of my image?

The border expands the canvas outward, so your image is never covered or cropped.

Can the corners be rounded?

Choose square corners for a classic frame, or round the outer corners for a softer look.

Is my image uploaded?

No — everything happens locally in your browser.
